campbell.title: Campbell City Council — September 15, 2026
campbell.summary: The Campbell City Council considered updates to the theater use policy, a cost-share agreement with the City of San Jose for resurfacing work, and the city's annual investment policy update for fiscal year 2026-27. The Council also considered a budget adjustment to fund a replacement project.
keyTopics: Proposed modifications to Council Policy Section 14 (Theater Use Policy)
Cost-share agreement with the City of San Jose, not to exceed $335,000, for resurfacing work
Annual update to the city's investment policy for fiscal year 2026-27
Budget adjustment to fund replacement of remaining equipment/infrastructure

saratoga.title: Saratoga City Council — September 16, 2026
saratoga.summary: The Saratoga City Council considered routine items like meeting minutes, check registers, and a conflict of interest code update, plus final map approvals for two residential lot splits. The Council also held public hearings on two appeals of Planning Commission decisions — one involving a new home and ADU on 6th Street, and another involving a three-lot subdivision on Oak Place — and discussed law enforcement service options ahead of upcoming town hall meetings.
keyTopics: Appeal of Planning Commission approval conditions for a house and ADU at 14650 6th Street
Appeal of Planning Commission approval of a three-lot subdivision at 14486 Oak Place
Law enforcement service options ahead of September 19 and 30 town hall meetings
Final map approvals for lot splits at 20517 Carniel Avenue and 19351 Saratoga Los Gatos Road
Update to the City's Conflict of Interest Code

los-altos.title: Los Altos City Council — September 22, 2026
los-altos.summary: The Los Altos City Council took up a routine wastewater treatment agreement, a VTA board reappointment, several city commission appointments, and an update to its legal services contract. It also considered an interim urgency ordinance placing a temporary moratorium on new applications related to detention or custodial processing facilities.
keyTopics: Interim urgency ordinance establishing a temporary moratorium on filing, accepting, processing, or approving applications for detention or custodial processing facilities
Addendum No. 14 to the Regional Water Quality Control Plant agreement with Palo Alto and Mountain View
Reappointment of Councilmember Jonathan D. Weinberg to the VTA Board for another two-year term
Appointments to the Complete Streets, Environmental, and Planning Commissions
Amendment to the city's legal services agreement with Berliner Cohen, LLP, updating retainer and hourly rate terms

los-gatos.title: Los Gatos Town Council — September 15, 2026
los-gatos.summary: The Town Council reviewed routine business, including approval of minutes from earlier September meetings and a monthly financial and investment report for July 2026. The Council also considered several contract actions, including amendments to service agreements and a heating/ventilation/air conditioning agreement, along with new professional services agreements.
keyTopics: Approval of minutes from the September 1, 2026 Town Council and Closed Session meetings
Monthly Financial and Investment Report for July 2026
A second amendment to an existing town agreement
A first amendment to a Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC) services agreement
New professional services agreements for the Town

san-jose.body: Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole
san-jose.title: San José Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole — September 23, 2026
san-jose.summary: The Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole reviewed the upcoming agendas for the September 29 and October 6, 2026 City Council meetings, including any new items or scheduling needs. The committee also considered the public record for a recent week, mayoral travel requests, and a funding approval request from District 1 involving San Jose Sharks Community Funds for a local government association.
keyTopics: Review and finalization of the September 29, 2026 Council agenda
Review of the draft October 6, 2026 Council agenda
Public record covering September 10–17, 2026
Mayor's requests to travel
District 1 request to approve San Jose Sharks Community Funds for the California Association of Local Agency Formation Commissions

mountain-view.title: Mountain View City Council — September 22, 2026
mountain-view.summary: The Mountain View City Council met in closed session to discuss potential legal action involving several fire truck manufacturers and to consider a City Attorney appointment, followed by a regular session covering proclamations, city policy updates, and several infrastructure and development items. Major topics on the public agenda included renovations to Shoreline athletic fields, a solar and battery storage energy project, updates to the historic preservation ordinance and zoning map, and a new Active Transportation Plan.
keyTopics: Closed-session discussion of potential legal action involving fire apparatus manufacturers (Pierce, Oshkosh, REV Group, Rosenbauer, and others)
Consideration of a City Attorney appointment in closed session
Professional services agreement for renovating the Shoreline athletic fields
Actions related to 2000 North Shoreline Boulevard and an energy services contract for solar panels and battery storage
Updates to the Historic Preservation Ordinance and zoning map, and adoption of the Active Transportation Plan

sunnyvale.title: Sunnyvale City Council — September 19, 2026
sunnyvale.summary: This was a special morning session of the Sunnyvale City Council focused on the annual 'State of the City' event. The agenda was largely procedural, covering the event schedule and standard logistical details for public participation rather than specific policy decisions.
keyTopics: State of the City special meeting and event schedule

cupertino.title: Cupertino City Council — September 15, 2026
cupertino.summary: The Cupertino City Council met on September 15, 2026, starting with closed-session discussions on potential litigation and a real estate negotiation involving property on Finch Avenue with the Cupertino Union School District. The public meeting included recognition of Cupertino High School students for their FBLA achievements, and the Council took up a routine consent calendar covering minutes, accounts payable, an audit committee ordinance, an AI policy, and a response to a county grand jury report on pothole damage claims. An ordinance updating building code definitions was postponed to October 6, 2026.
keyTopics: Closed session on anticipated litigation and property negotiations for 10480 Finch Avenue with Cupertino Union School District
Recognition of Cupertino High School students for the 2026 FBLA National Leadership Conference
Postponement of an ordinance revising municipal code definitions of 'attic,' 'garages,' and 'square footage' to October 6, 2026
Adoption of an Artificial Intelligence (AI) City Council Policy and updates to Audit Committee duties
Response to the Santa Clara County Civil Grand Jury report on improving pothole damage claims processes

santa-clara.title: Santa Clara City Council — September 22, 2026
santa-clara.summary: The Santa Clara City Council held a joint meeting with the Stadium Authority Board, opening with a closed session covering pending litigation with the Department of Water Resources, potential new litigation, and a property damage claim from Travelers Insurance. The Council also considered several proclamations and routine purchasing agreements for HVAC controls and office furnishings.
keyTopics: Legal matters discussed in closed session, including litigation with the California Department of Water Resources over Silicon Valley Power/Northern California Power Agency claims, anticipated litigation, and a property damage claim from Travelers Insurance
Deferral of an ordinance to establish new zoning rules (Chapter 18.68) for replacement housing units required under state law
Proclamations recognizing Hispanic Heritage Month, Childhood Cancer Awareness Month, and Public Power Week
Authorization for a purchase order/agreement with Syserco, Inc. for HVAC control systems
Increase to a purchase order with D & D Learning Spaces for office furniture purchase, delivery, installation, and removal

milpitas.title: Milpitas City Council — September 15, 2026
milpitas.summary: The Milpitas City Council reviewed a draft plan for federal Community Development Block Grant funding, considered updates on the city's red light camera traffic safety program, and looked at a report on the condition of the Milpitas Community Center. The Council also took up financial actions related to the former Redevelopment Agency's bond refunding.
keyTopics: Draft Program Year 2025 Community Development Block Grant Consolidated Plan
Presentation on the Red Light Camera Traffic Safety Program
Presentation on the condition of the Milpitas Community Center
Resolutions related to the sale and issuance of refunding bonds for the Successor Agency to the Redevelopment Agency

palo-alto.title: Palo Alto Architectural Review Board — September 17, 2026
palo-alto.summary: The Architectural Review Board considered a proposed sign program for the office/lab property at 950 Page Mill Road. The plan involves installing a single monument sign shared by multiple tenants that would display the property's own branding, 'Page Mill Labs,' alongside four separate panels identifying individual tenants.
keyTopics: Review of a Master Sign Program for 950 Page Mill Road
Proposed multi-tenant monument sign featuring 'Page Mill Labs' property branding
Four individual tenant identification panels included in the sign design
Project determined exempt from CEQA under the accessory structures exemption
